claims.quote: Mostly collected in the rio Negro basin, Amazonas state, Brazil, and in particular the rio Demini, a northern tributary flowing into the central Negro in the municipality of Barcelos.
P. leopardus was described from the Rupununi River in Guyana and the identity of this fish thus remains unconfirmed.
One of the most popular Pseudacanthicus is L114, which originates from the middle Rio Negro basin in Brazil.
However, the real P. leopardus originates from the border region of Brazil and Guyana.
